title: The feature list says both marketing websites are behind a switch, but they have been public since 22 October
what: The feature list marks the gym-owner website and the member website as 'behind switch'. Their switch has been on since 22 October, and today both live sites are exactly the files on main. The same list marks the AI helper on gym web pages only as 'behind switch', but it also waits for a database change that is not on the live database yet, so turning the switch on alone would not make it work.
expected: Both websites read 'live'. The AI helper reads 'behind switch and waiting for a database change'.
who: the owner reading the feature list
how_often: every time the list is read
fix_line: Mark the two websites live and the AI helper as also waiting for its database change
